capabilities: Draws === as a thick horizontal divider
Turns text above === into a heading, as --- does
Leaves === unchanged in code, math, quotes and callouts
Shows the raw === at the cursor for editing
Selects the === when the divider is clicked
extras: Has no settings; the divider takes the color and placement of the theme's --- divider. Source mode and other apps keep the plain === text.
intentEvidence: === is a thick ---, and nothing more.
problem: Obsidian's --- divider comes in a single weight, so a note has no heavier visual break to separate sections.
summary: Renders a line of === as a horizontal divider three times as thick as the one drawn by ---, without changing the note.
